title: Reproduction code and results for "Nearest-neighbour distances and prediction error in spatial cross-validation"
description: Code, data and saved results that reproduce every figure, table and reported number in the paper "Nearest-neighbour distances and prediction error in spatial cross-validation" by Olatunji Johnson. Run python3 reproduce.py render to regenerate the outputs from the saved results, or python3 reproduce.py compute to rerun all studies. See README.md and REPRODUCING.md.

creators.name: Johnson, Olatunji
